The '''eastern swamps''' was an area of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that was the only known location of the [[Perlote tree/Legends|perlote tree]] and [[Slug-beetle/Legends|slug-beetle]]. It was beneath these swamps that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established an underground [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] to create the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. Its grid coordinates were SP1-2-7.
